name: astral-orchestrator
description: Astral Orchestrator helps people plan, complete, and check projects in Codex by choosing an appropriate workflow and coordinating the work.

interface.longDescription: Astral Orchestrator helps you turn an idea or request into finished, checked work in Codex. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it chooses a suitable workflow, breaks larger jobs into manageable pieces, coordinates the work, and checks the result. It can move quickly for simple tasks or add extra safeguards for risky changes, so you spend less time managing the process and more time reviewing a clear outcome.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral: Orbit default; Comet tiny; Event Horizon high-risk; Singularity one verified Sol session.
Use Astral in Pulsar or Morph mode for this explicit opt-in request.
Use Astral in Constellation mode for an explicit opt-in independent-card request.
